reviewed_changes: Settings gains General, Connections and System tabs in a left rail; General holds appearance and playback, Connections holds Spotify, Discord and the new opt-in Last.fm section, System holds updates and cache

The sidebar gains Home at the top and loses Favorites, so all 156 full-window references change; Settings also gets the wider (11 rem) tab rail, a Normalize volume switch (off by default) and the version 0.8.21; the other 20 references (sign-in screens) are pixel-identical to 0.8.19

Renamed to Sonder with a ripple mark on a dark grey tile: the sidebar brand, its logo and the fixture artist text change in every full-window reference, and Settings shows version 0.8.22 and Sonder wording; the 20 sign-in references only change where they name the app

The mascot is removed: the Settings Mascot row and the four open-selector references are gone, the Playback card now holds Autoplay and Normalize volume, and the sidebar logo is the new near-black tile with a thin chrome rim; Settings shows version 0.8.23

Track lists lose the favorites star column and its header icon; Home gains Last 4 weeks / Last 6 months / All time buttons and a rank under each artist (replacing the word Artist); Settings shows version 0.8.24

UI zoom is now a seven-step Dense to Spacious scale (70-130%) in Settings, with 70% and 130% replacing the old 75% and 125% zoom scenes; Settings gains a Streaming quality row (Very high by default); Home gains a New from artists section below the top artists; the sidebar mark is redrawn with a firmer chrome rim; Settings shows version 0.8.25

Eight new references: Premium-required (shown to free Spotify accounts instead of the app closing), Home with top artists and tracks, and Home asking for the new top-items permission; each in dark/light and regular/compact
The Cache text now mentions the bounded on-disk artwork cache (48 MiB); Clear cache empties memory and disk
Last.fm scrobbling is event-driven with one idle worker thread, one exact timer and a bounded retry queue; its secret and session key stay in the system keychain
Liking or unliking keeps the library fingerprint current so refreshes stay two-request probes; the audio writer wakes every 10 ms instead of 2 ms and the backend runtime uses two worker threads

The track right-click menu gains a Copy Spotify link row above Open track in Spotify; Settings shows version 0.8.26; Home also gains a Coming soon row and a NEW badge on fresh releases, which only appear with live data, so no reference shows them
Settings shows version 0.8.27; Home now opens first and shows placeholder cards while its release rows load, which no reference captures because the scenes answer every request
Settings shows version 0.8.28; no other reference changes

Album pages gain a Review album pill (album-tint changes); four new album-review references show the inline rating row, progress bar and locked rows; search results lead with filter chips, a Top result card and Songs, then Artists and Albums (search-artists, search-gallery-scrolled); the search dropdown gains a Search Spotify row (search-cached); Settings shows version 0.8.29

Local Files adds eight references: the Local Files page with two folders' worth of tagged tracks, embedded album art and a local song paused in the player, and the Settings Local Files section with two folders; the sidebar shows a Local Files row only once a folder is added, so the other 184 references are pixel-identical to 0.8.29
Local Files gains a search box beside Folders, and Settings shows version 0.8.30; the other 184 references are pixel-identical to 0.8.29

The sidebar and sign-in logo is a flat tile with no rim (sharper at small sizes on Windows), so every full-window and sign-in reference changes; the search dropdown gains an On Spotify section with live artist and album results; Settings shows version 0.8.31

Lyrics: Settings gains a Lyrics section (Show lyrics, off by default) below Local Files, and four new references show the side panel with the current line large and nearby lines fading; album pages use a 232px cover beside the title; Settings shows version 0.8.32; the other 176 references are pixel-identical to 0.8.31

Settings shows version 0.8.33; lyrics lines above the current one are now visible (the column glides instead of windowing), so the four lyrics references change; the search dropdown is now opaque so the page title no longer shows through it (search-cached), and the new search-live references show its On Spotify results
Settings shows version 0.8.34; lyric lines keep their wrapping as they grow into focus (each line is as wide as its type is big), so the four lyrics references change
Settings shows version 0.8.36; album review now locks each song until it has been heard, and the review screenshots are pixel-identical because their scene plays each song first

Settings shows version 0.8.35; the artist header now scrolls away with the page while the toolbar name and cover grow out of the search bar, and the resting and fully docked artist references are pixel-identical

Playback problems add twelve references: the dialog for an account Spotify won't stream to (streaming-refused), the dialog for playback that could not connect with Try again and Set up again (playback-not-connected), and the wait for approval in the browser (playback-approval); they only appear on those failures, so the other 184 references are pixel-identical to 0.8.29
Settings shows version 0.8.37; the twelve playback-problem references merged from PR #11 were re-captured on the current build (flat Sonder logo); the other references are pixel-identical

Settings shows version 0.8.38; empty and error pages use one centred icon, title and help layout, so the playlist-denied and search-entered, -cached and -live references changed, and four new search-empty references show No results

In 0.8.39 the sidebar gains a What's new row after the last library item (with a red dot until it is opened) and an update card at its foot when an update is offered, so nearly every full-window capture changed; four whats-new references are new, the update-available references show the card, and Settings shows version 0.8.39 plus the Install updates automatically and What's new rows
